name: AppHeader
description: Generic top-bar shell with three slots: `start`, `children` (middle), and `actions` (end). Renders a sticky dark surface; consumers compose any content into the slots. The sidebar collapse toggle, br…
descriptionFull: Generic top-bar shell with three slots: `start`, `children` (middle), and `actions` (end). Renders a sticky dark surface; consumers compose any content into the slots. The sidebar collapse toggle, brand logo, stats strip, and action buttons are all caller-provided — this component owns no domain

props.name: logo
props.description: Left-most slot — typically the app's brand lockup / logo

props.name: start
props.description: Left-edge content — e.g. a sidebar collapse toggle or brand wordmark

props.name: children
props.description: Middle slot — e.g. the dashboard stats strip or page title

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-edge action cluster — e.g. alarms bell, profile menu, or sign-out

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class hook for the outer `<header>` element

props.name: sticky
props.description: Render the header sticky to the top of its scroll container
